sections.heading: Wedding Cakes Designed Around Your Celebration
sections.lead: A custom wedding cake can become part of the celebration's visual story while remaining practical for the chosen cake format and venue.
paragraphs: PureBakes creates made-to-order wedding cakes around the couple, the setting and the overall mood of the event. The direction may be floral and romantic, elegant and minimal, contemporary, rich with metallic-look detail or built around a tiered composition.

Share the elements that matter to you rather than choosing only from a fixed catalogue. Décor, invitation artwork, outfits, flowers, colours and reference cakes can help establish an original direction for the finished design.

sections.heading: Wedding Cake Styles
sections.lead: Real PureBakes work supports a range of wedding and reception cake directions, from restrained designs to cakes with greater height and detail.

items.title: Floral wedding cakes
items.text: Floral arrangements can create a soft, romantic or contemporary direction. Share the wedding flowers and palette so appropriate decorative options can be discussed.

items.title: Elegant and minimal cakes
items.text: Clean tiers, a restrained palette and carefully placed details can create visual presence without making the composition feel crowded.

items.title: Gold and metallic-look cakes
items.text: Gold, pearl and metallic-look accents can be balanced with white, blush, deeper colours or textured finishes for a refined celebration aesthetic.

items.title: Contemporary wedding cakes
items.text: Abstract colour, modern texture, asymmetric arrangements and mixed decorative details can shape a less traditional design direction.

items.title: Tiered wedding cakes
items.text: Two-tier, three-tier and other multi-tier formats can provide visual scale and more space for changing textures, florals or personalised details where practical.

items.title: Romantic and personalised designs
items.text: Initials, names, a date, monogram, suitable topper or couple detail can give the cake a personal focal point.

items.title: Reception cakes
items.text: A reception cake can be planned around the venue aesthetic, décor and the prominence you want it to have within the celebration setting.

sections.heading: Choosing Tiers and Cake Format
sections.lead: The suitable format depends on the cake requirement, visual direction and practical arrangements rather than a fixed rule about guest numbers.
paragraphs: A single-tier wedding cake can suit an intimate celebration or a design where decorative restraint matters. A two-tier or multi-tier cake adds height and creates separate surfaces for florals, colour, texture, initials or a topper.
Share the approximate cake requirement and whether visual scale is important. Design complexity, balance and transport should be considered together before the number of tiers is confirmed.

sections.heading: Personalising Your Wedding Cake
sections.lead: Reference images are useful for communicating a style, but the final cake should be planned for your own wedding rather than promised as an exact copy.
paragraphs: You can send a cake reference together with invitation artwork, wedding colours, outfit details, floral arrangements, décor or venue images. Explain which elements you want the cake to echo so the overall palette and decorative balance can be discussed.
Initials, names, the wedding date, a monogram, a suitable topper or another meaningful detail can be considered where the selected cake format allows it to remain clear and well proportioned.

sections.heading: Wedding Cake Flavours and Eggless Options
sections.lead: Flavour and egg or eggless preference should be discussed alongside the design, cake format and celebration date.
paragraphs: Current PureBakes cake information includes vanilla, chocolate, strawberry, red velvet, butterscotch, Biscoff and caramel, mango and Indian-inspired flavour directions. Available choices and whether different flavours are practical across tiers should be confirmed for the selected cake.
PureBakes offers both egg and eggless wedding cakes. Eggless preparation is an ordering preference and does not imply suitability for a medical or allergy-related requirement.

sections.heading: Planning Your Wedding Cake
sections.lead: Begin with the wedding or reception date, then bring the visual and practical requirements into one conversation.

items.title: 1. Share the date
items.text: Send the required wedding or reception date so availability can be checked before the design is confirmed.

items.title: 2. Send your references
items.text: Share cake inspiration and any relevant décor, invitation, flower, outfit or venue references.

items.title: 3. Discuss the format
items.text: Confirm the approximate cake requirement, tier direction, flavour, egg or eggless preference and personal details.

items.title: 4. Review practical arrangements
items.text: Share the venue or destination and timing so the proposed cake format and transport arrangement can be considered together.

items.title: 5. Confirm the order
items.text: Once the design and date are agreed, a 50% advance secures the order. The balance is completed before the cake is handed over or a delivery cab is arranged.

sections.heading: Transport and Venue Considerations
sections.lead: Larger or tiered wedding cakes can require additional planning around the finished format, destination and event timing.
paragraphs: Share the venue or destination while discussing the design. The number of tiers, decorative details and finished cake format can affect what transport arrangement is practical.

Cab delivery assistance depends on the cake, destination and what can be arranged for the date. Venue setup, installation and delivery arrangements should not be assumed; any specific requirement should be discussed before the order is confirmed.

sections.heading: Wedding Cakes Across Hyderabad
sections.lead: PureBakes creates wedding and reception cakes for celebrations across Hyderabad.
paragraphs: Share the destination together with the date and cake requirement so availability and practical arrangements can be reviewed for your celebration.
The Areas We Serve page provides local cake inspiration and ordering information without acting as a guaranteed delivery boundary.

relatedCelebrations.title: Engagement Cakes
relatedCelebrations.description: Explore engagement cake ideas when the visual direction begins with the ring ceremony or when you want the engagement and wedding designs to feel connected but distinct.

relatedCelebrations.title: Anniversary Cakes
relatedCelebrations.description: Browse anniversary cake ideas for later milestones, including floral, photo-led, elegant and couple-focused directions.

faqs.question: Can you customise a wedding cake from a reference image?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share the reference and explain which colours, details or overall direction you like. PureBakes can discuss how to adapt it into an original design for your wedding cake requirement.

faqs.question: Can the cake match our wedding décor or invitation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share décor, invitation, flower, outfit or colour references so the cake palette and decorative direction can be planned around the celebration.

faqs.question: Do you make tiered wedding cakes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Two-tier, three-tier and other multi-tier wedding cakes can be discussed. The suitable format depends on the cake requirement, design and practical arrangements rather than a fixed guest-count rule.

faqs.question: Can we personalise the wedding cake with initials or names?
faqs.answer: Yes. Initials, names, a date, monogram, suitable topper or another meaningful detail can be considered where it works with the selected cake format and design.

faqs.question: Are eggless wedding cakes available?
faqs.answer: Yes. PureBakes offers both egg and eggless wedding cakes. Mention your preference while discussing the flavour, tiers, design and date.

faqs.question: What flavours are available for wedding cakes?
faqs.answer: Available flavours depend on the selected cake and requirement. Current PureBakes cake information includes vanilla, chocolate, strawberry, red velvet, butterscotch, Biscoff and caramel, mango and Indian-inspired directions.

faqs.question: How do we choose the wedding cake size or tier format?
faqs.answer: Share the approximate cake requirement, design references and whether visual height is important. PureBakes can then discuss a practical single-tier, two-tier or multi-tier direction without relying on a fixed guest-count formula.

faqs.question: Can transport be arranged for a wedding cake?
faqs.answer: Cab delivery assistance may be discussed depending on the finished cake, destination, timing and what can be arranged for the date. Share the venue details while enquiring; delivery or venue setup is not guaranteed.

faqs.question: How early should we enquire for a wedding cake?
faqs.answer: Availability depends on the date and design complexity. Enquire once your wedding or reception date is known so PureBakes can confirm what is practical.

finalCta: Share your wedding or reception date, venue or destination and the cake direction you have in mind. We’ll check availability and continue with you on WhatsApp.
